name: BotOS Verification Skill
title_zh: PR 合并前把 BotOS 功能从头到尾验一遍的检查
tagline_zh: 不用自己列清单、记步骤，它按端到端流程逐项验证 BotOS 新功能；测完自动出报告，合并前心里有底。
tagline_en: No more ad-hoc testing—it walks through the full workflow step by step, flags gaps, and reports before you merge.
desc_en: End-to-end verification workflow for BotOS features before PR merge
why_zh: 把「验证」从随手试两下变成可复现的流程，每次 PR 都走同一套标准，漏测的角落它会替你盯住。
why_en: Turns verification into a repeatable gate: same checklist every PR, catches what manual poking tends to miss.
limit_zh: 只认 BotOS 仓库内的功能验证，不处理外部依赖或跨仓库联调；需要本地能跑起 BotOS 环境。
limit_en: BotOS repo only; no cross-repo or external deps. Needs runnable local BotOS env and testable points in PR desc.
title_en: End-to-end BotOS feature verifier before PR merge
